messages:
Asha (runtime): Following the postmortem, let's convert the remediation list into a repeatable cadence. Root causes: slow shard KV-cache leak, allocator fragmentation, and OOM spikes with certain seq-length patterns.
Miguel: Agreed. Suggest splitting into immediate guards (soft limits, alerts) and medium-term profiling + GC work.
Priya: Immediate actions: implement per-shard soft eviction and a configurable hard cap. I can own the code change. ETA: end of week. @Miguel can you add unit + integration tests? :thumbsup:
Miguel: Yep. I'll add tests and a micro load harness that reproduces residency growth. ETA Wed.
Jin: Medium-term: run repeated profiled runs with slab-sampling and allocator flags, capture pprof heap and goroutine traces. I can run three profiles (cold start, warm start, sustained 10m).
Asha (runtime): Jin, please upload traces to INF-842 and include pprof commands. Example:
```
pprof -http=localhost:8080 /srv/runtime/proc -symbolize=none --alloc_space
curl -sS http://localhost:8080/debug/pprof/heap > heap.pprof
```
Miguel: I'll also add a CI job asserting per-shard residency growth is <10% after 5m under synthetic load and fail the job otherwise. Filing ticket now.
Priya: Ownership recap: Priya -> eviction + hard caps + rollback gating; Miguel -> tests, CI job, PRs; Jin -> profiler traces + GC tuning experiments; Sam (oncall) -> canary run + 48h monitoring.
Sam (oncall): I'll run the canary and tighten the KV-residency trend alert sensitivity. Will watch for regression.
Asha (runtime): Timeline: soft fixes and alert tweaks by EOW; canary deploy next Tuesday; GC/allocator tuning and telemetry work in the next 2-week sprint. Any objections?
Miguel: Fine. I'll link PRs to the postmortem and add changelog entries.
Jin: Add fragmentation metric to telemetry: resident_chunks vs alloc_chunks ratio. I'll prototype a query and post here.
Priya: Add rollback playbook: if canary shows >5% error rate or sustained memory drift >20% within 2 hours, revert to previous image and open an incident.
ops-bot: Added incident runbook snippet and alert thresholds to ticket INF-842.
Asha (runtime): Good. Check-in Friday 10:00 PT. I'll update the postmortem with owners/timestamps and mark actions as in-progress. Thanks all. :rocket:
